proto.export.desc: Snapshot of the current game x layout scope. Coordinates are per-display logical coordinates; no global desktop coordinates are stored.
proto.export.title: Export configuration JSON
proto.game.note.rise: Monster Hunter: Rise · palico UI available
proto.game.note.world: Monster Hunter: World · no palico UI
proto.help.p1: This is an offline HTML prototype: every value is demo data. It never talks to the game process and never reads or writes panels.ini.
proto.help.p2: Display semantics: a split sub-window's explicit target wins, otherwise it inherits its panel's default screen, then falls back to the primary DP-1. Inheritance is a normal setting, not a warning.
proto.help.p3: There are four game x layout scopes; each stores window target screen, position, scale, opacity and section switches independently, so switching back and forth never bleeds values.
proto.help.p4: Save only writes browser localStorage (demo data); Export JSON copies or downloads the current snapshot.
